title: Pre-Registered Predictions for the Entropy Flow Cosmology (EFC) Model
description: This preregistration freezes and publicly archives the Energy-Flow Cosmology (EFC) model’s benchmark parameters, EFT mapping, and a sealed set of testable observational predictions prior to Euclid DR1, Rubin DP2, and SO×Euclid releases. It specifies percent-level shifts of key observables relative to ΛCDM on Euclid quasi-linear scales, the characteristic µ<1, Σ>1, η>1 signature, and explicit kill criteria, all anchored by DOIs and a SHA-256 hash.

EFC_action.latex: S_{\mathrm{EFC}} = \int d^4x\,\sqrt{-g}\,\Big[ \tfrac{1}{2} M_{\rm Pl}^2 F(\phi) R - \tfrac{1}{2} K(\rho)\, g^{\mu\nu} \partial_{\mu}\phi\,\partial_{\nu}\phi - V(\phi) - \lambda\, \Box \phi - \Gamma(\rho) \Big],\quad F(\phi)=1+\alpha_\phi\,\phi
EFC_action.description: Relativistic action defining EFC with a non-minimal coupling F(ϕ), density-dependent kinetic stiffness K(ρ), potential V(ϕ), a Lagrange multiplier λ enforcing the flow constraint, and an entropy-flow term Γ(ρ).

alpha_functions.latex: \alpha_M(a) = M_0\, S(a),\quad \alpha_B(a) = B_0\, \frac{dS}{d\ln a},\quad \alpha_T=0,\quad S(a) = \big[1+\exp\!\big(-\tfrac{\ln a - \ln a_t}{\Delta}\big)\big]^{-1}
alpha_functions.description: Bellini–Sawicki EFT functions used in the Boltzmann integration via a logistic (sigmoid) transition S(a); the tensor speed excess is set to zero (c_T=c).

modified_gravity_observables.description: Scale- and redshift-dependent effective gravitational coupling (µ), lensing modification (Σ), and gravitational slip (η) computed from EFC perturbations in conformal Newtonian gauge.

key_results.main_finding: All EFC benchmark parameters and opposite-sign growth–lensing predictions are preregistered and sealed, with specific percent-level shifts (P1–P5) vs. ΛCDM on Euclid DR1 scales and the characteristic signature µ<1, Σ>1, η≈1.10.
datasets_used: DESI DR2 BAO (context for regime-transition fit)

sealed_predictions.statement: Survival valley signature on 0.5 ≲ z ≲ 1: µ(z) < 1 (≈ 0.94), Σ(z) > 1 (≈ 1.05), and η(z) ≈ 1.10 (positive slip), distinguishing EFC from f(R) (µ>1) and ΛCDM (η=1).
sealed_predictions.falsifiable_by: Combined Euclid DR1 growth and lensing consistency tests of µ, Σ, and η on quasi-linear scales.

sealed_predictions.statement: σ8 shift relative to ΛCDM at fixed background: +1.21% at the EFC benchmark.
sealed_predictions.falsifiable_by: Euclid DR1 growth (RSD/clustering) with matched background and systematics corrections.

sealed_predictions.statement: Matter power spectrum at k = 0.05 h/Mpc, z = 0.5: +2.09% vs. ΛCDM.
sealed_predictions.falsifiable_by: Euclid DR1 galaxy clustering on quasi-linear scales with window/convolution corrections.

sealed_predictions.statement: Lensing potential power C_ℓ^{ϕϕ} at ℓ = 66: −6.01% vs. ΛCDM.
sealed_predictions.falsifiable_by: Weak-lensing and CMB-lensing measurements (Euclid × CMB) on matched multipoles.

sealed_predictions.statement: EG statistic at ℓ = 66: −3.98% vs. ΛCDM.
sealed_predictions.falsifiable_by: Galaxy–lensing + RSD joint EG analysis (Simons Observatory × Euclid).

sealed_predictions.statement: ISW contribution C_ℓ^{TT} at ℓ = 30: +1.88% vs. ΛCDM.
sealed_predictions.falsifiable_by: Planck low-ℓ TT and ISW–LSS cross-correlations with consistent masks and calibrations.

kill_criteria: KC1: If EG(ℓ≈66) is consistent with ΛCDM within |ΔEG| < 1% at ≥2σ (including systematics), i.e., no ≈ −3.98% shift, the EFC benchmark coupling is falsified.
KC2: Any sealed observable P1–P5 exhibits an opposite-sign shift relative to ΛCDM at ≥2σ after window/convolution and systematic corrections.
KC3: Euclid DR1 growth and lensing sectors shift with the same sign near k≈0.05 h/Mpc (or ℓ≈66) at ≥2σ, violating the EFC coherence pattern (µ<1 with Σ>1).
KC4: Independent reproduction with hi_class + efc_logistic shows Horndeski stability violation (c_s^2 ≤ 0 or Q_S ≤ 0) on 0 < z < 3 at the benchmark.
